title: Blow-ups converging in mass to c[[span τ]]: the pulled-back mass measures converge vaguely to |c|·Hⁿ⌞span τ
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), a ∈ ℝ^P, (λ_j)_{j∈ℕ} with λ_j > 0, C' ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), τ : Fin n → ℝ^P orthonormal with Q' := span(range τ), and c ∈ ℤ with c ≠ 0, such that C'(ω) = c·∫_{Q'} ω(x)(τ) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n, Hⁿ := μHE[n]) and MassMeasuresConverge (j ↦ blowUp C a λ_j) C' holds. Then for every integer multiplicity representation R ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) of C and every continuous compactly supported g : ℝ^P → ℝ, λ_j^{−n}·∫ g(η_j(x)) dR.measure(x) → |c|·∫_{Q'} g dHⁿ as j → ∞, where η_j := dilation a λ_j (η_j(x) = λ_j^{−1}(x − a)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (a : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j) (C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (c : ℤ), Orthonormal ℝ τ → c ≠ 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, C' ω = (c : ℝ) * ∫ x in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x τ ∂μHE[n]) → MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp C a (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C' → ∀ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.Represents C → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun j => (lams j)⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ x, g (dilation a (lams j) x) ∂R.measure) atTop (𝓝 ((c.natAbs : ℝ) * ∫ x in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), g x ∂μHE[n]))
